name_en: Kaku zushi — box-pressed sushi layered with seasoned vegetables inside
summary_ja: 四角い木型に酢飯と具を詰めて押す芸北地域の押し寿司。しめさばや錦糸卵を上に彩りよく並べ、中にはやや辛めに煮た野菜を仕込み、食べ進めると味の変化が楽しめると伝わる。
summary_en: Vinegared rice and toppings are packed into a square wooden mold and pressed into shape in this dish from Hiroshima's Geihoku mountains. Colorful mackerel and egg crepe sit on top, while root vegetables simmered a little saltier hide inside, giving the flavor a shift partway through eating.

name_en: Azuma — hand-formed sushi using vinegared okara in place of rice
summary_ja: 酢でしめたママカリを、酢飯の代わりに味付けしたおからで握る沿岸部の寿司。米が貴重だった時代、手に入りやすいおからで代用したのが始まりとされ、祭りや正月に振る舞われてきた。
summary_en: Sardine-like mamakari, cured in vinegar, is pressed onto seasoned okara instead of vinegared rice in this coastal sushi. It is said to have begun as a way to stretch scarce rice by substituting the cheap, plentiful soy pulp, and was served at festivals and New Year's gatherings.
